note: Adapted from the original English description by Emerson 1952; the holotype is from the Oronoque River, Guyana. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 24 of the original, in millimetres. The alate and worker are not described in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Among the species of this genus whose head is covered with a short hair mat, this species has the sharpest lateral corners of the labrum (each nearly a right angle or slightly more), which distinguishes it from C. incisus, C. villosus, C. ovatus, C. bequaerti and C. pilosus, which also have a short hair mat; C. ovatus is larger, with a proportionally wider head whose sides are more curved and more convergent anteriorly.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Both the upper and lower surfaces of the head covered with numerous setae and a dense short hair mat; postmentum covered with a short hair mat and with a few setae at the anterior end; pronotum with numerous setae and some short hairs at the sides and on the anterior margin; tergites with many setae and some very fine hairs; sternites with setae and hairs. Head subrectangular, the sides nearly straight, parallel or slightly convergent anteriorly. Frontal tube thick at the base, slightly upturned in lateral view. The narrowest part of the postmentum slightly more than half the widest (0.35:0.66 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length, or segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3. Lateral corners of the labrum distinct, each nearly a right angle or slightly more, the margin between the base of the white median lobe and the lateral corners slightly concave. Anterior margin of the pronotum weakly concave. Measurements (mm; Table 24 of the original, n=25, mean in parentheses): head length including the mandibles 4.08—4.57 (4.33); head length to the apex of the frontal tube 2.72—3.06 (2.90); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 2.80—3.27 (3.10); head width 2.12—2.37 (2.24); head thickness 1.59—1.76 (1.68); frontal tube length 0.39—0.47 (0.42); labrum width 0.75—0.83 (0.79); left mandible length 1.49—1.60 (1.55); right mandible length from the notch 0.79—0.86 (0.82); pronotum length 0.66—0.75 (0.71); pronotum width 1.12—1.31 (1.24); hind tibia length 1.85—2.06 (1.99).
